Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
c_tech2_user varchar2(6) := NULL;
c_tech1_user varchar2(6) := NULL;
begin

 if :ctrl_blk.test_id is null then
 show_error('18068') ; /* Test ID cannot be null */
 end if;

 /* Check whether Tech1 has already entered the band values for this unit */

 begin
 select tech1_user,
 tech2_user
 into c_tech1_user,
 c_tech2_user
 from test_band_header
 where unit_id= :ctrl_blk.unit_id
 and coll_date=:ctrl_blk.coll_date
 and test_id= :ctrl_blk.test_id
 and recon_flag='N';

 if c_tech1_user is null then
 show_error('18162'); /* This is unlikely to happen */
 elsif c_tech1_user=:banner.user_id then
 show_error('18075'); /* Super user cannot be same as that of First Tech */
 end if;
 
 if c_tech2_user is null then
 show_error('18163');
 elsif c_tech2_user=:banner.user_id then
 show_error('18076'); /* Super user cannot be same as that of Second Tech */
 end if;

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1227'); /* Invalid Test ID */
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 /* Check whether test exists in valid_tests */

 begin
 select test_desc
 into :ctrl_blk.descr
 from valid_tests_don
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk.test_id
 and test_group = 'CNFRM';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1227'); /* Invalid Test ID */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 :global.tech1 := c_tech1_user;
 :global.tech2 := c_tech2_user;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_old (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_procesing IS

 band_count number :=0;

begin

 begin
 select count(*)
 into band_count
 from valid_test_bands
 where test_id=:ctrl_blk.test_id
 and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if band_count >0 then
 :global.test_band_detail := 'YES';
 :ctrl_blk.req_flag := 'NO';
 go_block('test_band_detail');
 execute_query;
 :ctrl_blk.req_flag:='YES';
 else
 disable_test_band_detail;
 :global.test_band_detail := 'NO';
 go_field('res_blk.interpretation');
 end if; 

 :ctrl_blk.first_tech := :global.tech1;
 :ctrl_blk.second_tech:= :global.tech2;
 
 /* Disable all control block items */

 item_change('ctrl_blk.unit_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.test_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.pb_test_lov','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.coll_date','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.pb_coll_date','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.retrieve','D');
 
end ;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_COLL_DATE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct trunc(coll_date) from test_band_header where unit_id=:ctrl_blk.unit_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_VALID_RESULTS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select result_code , description from valid_test_results_don a , valid_master_codes b where a.test_id = :ctrl_blk.test_id and b.code_type='RESUL' and b.code=a.result_code order by result_code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_VALID_TESTS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select a.test_id,test_desc from valid_tests_don a,test_band_header b where b.unit_id=:ctrl_blk.unit_id and b.tech1_user!=:banner.user_id and b.tech2_user!=:banner.user_id and b.recon_flag='N' and a.test_id=b.test_id and a.test_group='CNFRM' order by a.test_id
